title: CNN-consensus / distortion-faithful cases
description: Samples where PSNR, SSIM, MT, the direct-error group, and the configured physics group all favor CNN.

title: GAN-distributional cases
description: Samples where PSNR/SSIM/direct-error metrics favor CNN, but the distributional group favors GAN.

title: PD-vs-MT disagreement cases
description: Samples where PD and MT choose different topology winners.

title: Candidate structural-hallucination signature cases
description: Samples where PD favors GAN but MT favors CNN; these are candidates where GAN may have plausible persistence statistics but different merge hierarchy.

title: MT-GAN diagnostic cases
description: Samples where MT favors GAN despite SSIM/PSNR being CNN-favoring in this dataset.

title: Topology-consensus GAN cases
description: Samples where both PD and MT favor GAN.

title: Topology-consensus CNN cases
description: Samples where both PD and MT favor CNN.

title: Near-tie topology-validator disagreement cases
description: SSIM-near-tie samples where SSIM and configured validators favor CNN but PD and MT favor GAN.
